verdict.rationale: Sift documents a broad first-party REST API surface (Events, Decisions, Score, Workflows and Webhooks APIs), so many core console actions such as recording events, applying decisions and retrieving scores are programmatic. Nothing establishes parity with the console: workflow authoring, Review Queues and Explore are only shown as console views. Missing for 10: an explicit API-parity claim, documented API coverage of workflow creation, review-queue management and console exploration, and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
